title: 휴대폰 개통하기: 외국인등록증 있으세요?
summary: Understand a phone store staff's polite questions and answer them.
setting: A mobile phone store. You want to get a new phone line. The staff speaks politely to you with -(으)세요?.

task.title: Staff or customer form
task.line: Read each line and decide who is speaking. The staff uses -(으)세요 for you. You use -아요/-어요 for yourself.

words.meaning: to get a phone line turned on (new number or new phone)
words.exampleMeaning: I got my new phone turned on today.

words.meaning: residence card (ID card for foreign residents)
words.exampleMeaning: I don't have my residence card yet.
I want to change my phone plan.
I've used up all my data.

words.meaning: Do you have ...? (polite, said to a customer)

dialogue.meaning: Hello. I'd like to get a new phone line.
Sure. Do you have your residence card?
Do you use a lot of data?

dialogue.korean: 네, 많이 써요. 영상을 자주 봐요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I use a lot. I watch videos often.

dialogue.korean: 그럼 이 요금제가 좋아요. 여기에 사인해 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: Then this plan is good for you. Please sign here.

exercises: Choose the staff's polite question: 여권 (있어요 / 있으세요)?
Choose the customer's answer: 직원: 전화를 많이 하세요? 손님: 네, 많이 (하세요 / 해요).
Who says it, the staff or the customer? ① 영상을 자주 보세요? ② 저는 전화를 많이 안 해요. ③ 휴대폰이 두 개 있으세요?
Choose the right word: ① 한 달에 (데이터를 / 사인을) 얼마나 쓰세요? ② 이 (요금제 / 전화번호)는 데이터가 많아요.
answers: ① Staff ② Customer ③ Staff
